book.name: 1 TIMOTI
book.title: Timoti wana Leta Houwan Pol wana Leleli

content: Timoti wana Pagan Toekelesiya elal
Ebo nu pahepahenapu tonowak etega elana, bahi anam ni eelolol, yaa alom wam awatauwan nu ba pagasisi ni ola iya tamwam. Wam pagan bolau ha mul elal ni ola heliya talimwau.
Wam pagan evenakau elal ni ola heliya hinamwau. Bahi wam nuwatu ni nanak yowau ha mul elal, yaa wam pagan eliyalil ni ola heliya numwau.
Abuabulau Baliya
Abuabulau bolo nige tutuliyau nu label.

Yaa ebo abuabul natunau o ebo tubunau hi gan, wali abulilek enona ni masalem houwan wali matamatahikan eliyana, kaiwena tuwalali ya Yehoba i yaliyaya-an. Abuabul nihi matahikan, inoke wana matahikan eliyalil wali sauga wawaya nihi ginol lahe.
Abuabul toto nige tutunau ge iya maisena ya i minamina, he Yehoba i meltelian, inoke lan ge bulin i mimi awaawanun Yehoba eliyana labe kaiwena.
Yaa ebo abuabul totona i talamwan panayawi ana yaliyaya eliyana, inoke bwagana yawalina i gan, yayaluwana iyaka i aliga.
Inoke abuabulau ge tutuliyau ali logugui o nu baunan elal, inoke bahi etegana ana woliwoli gamagalau nihi pwapwawa.

He henala tutunau nige i mamatahikagil, henala hinana ge tamana nige i mamatahikagil, iya Yehoba wana kamwasa ana en i pek, ge wana pagan nanakina gamagalau bolo nige hi aabulilek wali pagan nanakina i bwata lake.

Abuabulau alaliya nu leli lowan, bolo hi batelel ekelesiya ana tuwalali kaiwena ge bosowaina labe nihi pwawa ekelesiya elana. Yaa abuabul etega alana nu leli lowan ya te ebo wana baliman sikisti ge i hek, ebo valila i mibubun lagona elana,

ge ebo wana ginol waiwaisal gamagalau hi atena: ginol ololana natunau i matahikagil bubun, i lobwalobwabwali, alona wana hanalau i tuwalali wana pan toabulilek elal, bolo ali pulowan gaganina i label, ge i logasisi wana ginol gegewena ni waisi.
Yaa yowau bolo nige ga hi liliki ge hi abuabul, bahi alaliya nu aahe, eba abwe ali nuwa ni alalolon, inoke wali bateli Keliso elana nihi apanak.
Yaka gamagalau nihi awa naknakagil ge nihi ba, “Ku kite, valila hi batelel Keliso wana tuwalali kaiwena, yaa wali bateli iyaka hi apanak.”

I ola al, bahi alaliya nu aahe, eba abwe nihi mibwagabwaga ge nihi nonawanawa ge nihi haha limi ona elal. Ge bugul etega al, abwe nihi loloba ge nihi logulogugui likalika, ge bugul bolo tage bahi nihi babaunan, yaka nihi baunan.
Inoke nuwau yowau bolo nige ga hi liliki ge hi abuabul, nihi alolon al, nihi ab, yaka natuliyau ge wali limi nihi matahikagil, inoke bahi toekelesiya ala topihigelgel ala ba nihi babaa.
Ya ba ola o, kaiwena abuabulau enuna Yeisu ana en iyaka hi pek ge Seitani wana kamwasa hi toulil.
Ebo yova toabulilek etega tutuna etega i abuabul, ni matahikan, yaka bahi ekelesiya ana pulowan ni giginol. Inoke ekelesiya abuabulau bolo nige tutuliyau ni matahikagil.
Ekelesiya ana Tohouwa Baliya
Ekelesiya ana tohouwa bolo papaatena ge panpankiti hi logasisi-an, ge tohouwa gegewel bolo hi tuwalali bubun, ali awatauwan ni gan ge ali mulolu nuku pwabwata.

Kaiwena Buki Bwabwalena i ba, “Sauga bulumakau nuku patuwalali witi ni poti lolowan ge enona ni lobabalem ana haka elana, bahi awalalagena nuku aam kaus, yaa wana tuwalali molana ni anan.” Ge Buki i ba al, “Totuwalali molana ni gan.”
Ebo gamagal etega tohouwa etega ana woliwoli ni ginol, bahi anana nu hahago, yaa ebo gamagalau labui o ebo eton nihi patunahot, inoke abwe analiya nu hago.
Tohouwa bolo nihi gegi, nu ba pahenapol toekelesiya mataliyaa, inoke avaliyau nihi lovakun ge bahi nihi giginol ola.

Yehoba matanaa, Keliso Yeisu matanaa, ge aneloseyau bwabwalel mataliyaa, ya ba pagasisewa logugui bolo o nu toulil bubun. Nu ginol ni olaolaek gamagalau gegewel elal, bahi tage nu logugui pagasisi enuna elal ge enuna nigeya.

Ebo wam nuwatu i ola gamagal etega ni tabwa ekelesiya ana tohouwa, bahi nu papatotoya. Wana pagan ga nu hile, mulaa abwe nimwam nu teli kokowanaa ge nu pwabwabwalena Yehoba wana tuwalali kaiwena. Ebo nu patotoya ge tau etega nige tau waiwaisana i oola nu hile, he i ola owa tau o ana tolabe wana gegi elana. Bahi nu oola, yaa wam pagan gegewena ni sapu.
He kaiwena sauga hi gewi u kasikasiyebwa, bahi wewel awawana nu iim, yaa oine kekeisi nu im ge tinem ni labe.
Gamagalau enuna wali gegi ana kite i mweyaha, inoke wali gegi ta atena houwan ga, mulaa abwe kotina i gan. Yaa enuna wali gegi i misumi, inoke mulaa hot abwe ta atena.
I ola al, ginol waiwaisal ali kite i mweyaha, ge bwagana enuna nihi misumi ga, he heliya al ge abwe ta atena. Inoke bahi nu papatotoya ge etimwawa gamagal etega nu teteli ni tatabwa tohouwa.
